metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Like Ex Machina, this is a highly intellectual, dialogue-driven science fiction film that deals with communication, high stakes, and complex themes.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: Matches the puzzle-box mystery structure of Gone Girl and Exam, keeping you guessing until the very end with high-stakes dramatic tension.

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: If you enjoyed the courtroom intensity of The Exorcism of Emily Rose and the shifting loyalties in Conclave, this legal psychological thriller will captivate you.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: For fans of Sicario and Gone Girl, this meticulous, slow-burn crime drama offers a dark, atmospheric, and highly compelling mystery.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: An incredibly intense, emotionally devastating thriller with high moral stakes that matches the dark, gritty tone of Sicario.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A deeply cynical and dark character study that matches the tense, high-stakes tone of Gone Girl and the moral complexity of The Master.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: Like The Others, this is a slow-burn, atmospheric historical horror film that focuses on isolation, dread, and psychological decay.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: An intensely disturbing horror-drama that matches the emotional complexity of The Exorcism of Emily Rose and the terrifying atmosphere of Smile 2.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: A brilliant, low-budget psychological sci-fi mystery. It perfectly matches the claustrophobic, conversation-driven intensity of Exam and It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: Matches the Gothic atmosphere of The Others and the psychological mind games of Gone Girl inside a dark mystery.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Fans of Gran Torino and Sicario will appreciate this bleak, tense, and incredibly violent modern western about fate and crime.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: Like Conclave, this is a grounded, high-stakes institutional drama driven entirely by tension, dialogue, and incredible ensemble performances.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: A gritty, incredibly intense sci-fi thriller with masterfully shot action, appealing to fans of 28 Days Later and The Hurt Locker.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: An intense, psychological two-hander featuring incredible powerhouse performances, matching the feverish, artistic tone of The Master.

metas.name: Fargo
metas.description: A classic crime film with a dark, quirky sense of humor that matches the tone of In Bruges and Seven Psychopaths perfectly.

metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: Like Exam and It's What's Inside, this is an incredibly tense dinner party thriller that slowly builds unbearable psychological dread.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A high-concept horror thriller that thrives on silence and high stakes, matching the suspenseful, localized survival themes of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description: For fans of The Artifice Girl and The Man from Earth, this is an ultra-realistic, deeply complex sci-fi mystery that demands full intellectual attention.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: Directed by David Fincher, this dark, gritty, and atmospheric mystery thriller aligns perfectly with the tone of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A sleek, high-concept sci-fi action thriller about tech-integration that fans of Ex Machina and energetic genre films will love.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A highly claustrophobic, character-driven mystery that mirrors the paranoid, isolated environment of Exam.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A sharp, darkly comedic thriller featuring a high-stakes scenario and biting satire, sharing DNA with In Bruges and It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: A bleak, legendary psychological crime thriller. It is highly recommended if you love the gritty atmosphere of Sicario and the dark puzzles of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: Since you enjoy mature animation like Princess Mononoke and psychological thrillers like Smile 2, this mind-bending anime masterpiece is a perfect fit.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: A isolated, thoughtful science fiction drama focusing on identity and technology, matching the intimate, existential sci-fi of Ex Machina.

metas.name: Mystic River
metas.description: Directed by Clint Eastwood (Gran Torino), this is a dark, heavy, and emotionally complex prestige crime drama with incredible performances.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: Written by the writer of Sicario, this gritty, intense thriller is set in a harsh landscape and deals with grief, justice, and survival.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: An absolute masterclass in genre-bending thriller and dark comedy, perfectly appealing to fans of Gone Girl and In Bruges.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: A devastatingly intense, prestige mystery drama from Denis Villeneuve that matches the emotional depth of Conclave and the high stakes of Sicario.

metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description: Directed by Alex Garland (Ex Machina), this combines mind-bending sci-fi with biological horror, perfect for fans of The Abyss.

metas.name: The Ritual
metas.description: A dark, intense supernatural horror movie that blends psychological guilt with terrifying monsters, ideal for fans of The Conjuring 2.

metas.name: Misery
metas.description: A classic psychological thriller that generates incredible claustrophobic tension, matching the intense struggle of Gone Girl.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: An epic, intense, and ruthless character study of greed and power, matching the prestige dramatic weight of The Master.

metas.name: Black Swan
metas.description: A frantic psychological thriller exploring madness and obsession in art, aligning with the dark, disorienting tone of Smile 2.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: A devastatingly emotional, prestige Studio Ghibli drama that captures the human cost of war with immense depth, matching The Wind Rises.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: A high-stakes psychological mystery filled with twists and paranoia, matching the tone of Lucky Number Slevin and Exam.

metas.name: Source Code
metas.description: A fast-paced, high-concept sci-fi mystery thriller about a man trying to solve a puzzle in a limited time, perfect for fans of Exam.

metas.name: Sunshine
metas.description: Directed by Danny Boyle (28 Days Later), this intense sci-fi thriller blends space exploration with psychological horror, similar to The Abyss.

metas.name: Calibre
metas.description: A hidden gem thriller on Netflix about a hunting trip gone wrong. It features unbearable tension and moral panic that will grip fans of Sicario.

metas.name: Apostle
metas.description: An intense, gritty, and highly atmospheric period horror film that will appeal to fans of The Witch and The Conjuring 2.
